_about: On-screen hooks in the short-video formats that are working now (POV, "Me when", "Nobody: / Me:", "Things that just make sense") for YardSwaps Studio short clips (studio/README.md). {thing} becomes the listing's short name ("forklift", "pressure washer") or, for a library clip, its category noun. Seller voice only (MESSAGING.md): free to list, the AI writes the listing, no selling fee. Never a promise of views, buyers or a sale, never a category count, never "free storefront". Each hook is also the YouTube title, so keep it under 90 characters. The weekly scorecard can retire a hook by adding it to "retired".
